mylang.version: unsupported; compiler SHA and audited source revision used

target_policy.my-llvm: default Zig/Clang-derived CPU/features; first target CPU and merged target features
target_policy.policy_note: Optimized default build policies; instruction sets are not matched across arms. No forced target tuning or disabled MyLang checks.
target_policy.rust_text: cargo release defaults, portable target; locked serde_json dependency
target_policy.mylang_symbols: --keep-symbols preserves names for profiling; release optimization remains enabled

integer_math.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures

float_math.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
float_math.description: exact dyadic f64 multiply/add, scaled integer fold

branch_predictable.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures

branch_mixed.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures

record_construct.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
record_construct.description: construct a three-scalar record and read fields

record_update.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
record_update.description: copy an existing record, update three fields, read fields

call_direct.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
call_direct.description: ordinary direct call to affine helper A

call_indirect.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
call_indirect.description: seed-selected first-class callable A or B

option_handle.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
option_handle.description: native optional scalar, 3/4 present by input residue

result_propagate.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
result_propagate.description: native result propagated through a second helper, 4/5 success

binary_search.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
binary_search.description: checked binary search of sorted scalar keys

packet_decode.unit: one complete pass over SIZE fixtures
packet_decode.description: validate byte frames and decode record results

lox_eval.unit: one complete bytecode program execution with SIZE loop iterations

bytes_scan.description: Sum every input byte XOR a changing 8-bit mask.

string_equal.description: Rotate long equal, late mismatch, early mismatch, and short UTF-8 equal pairs.

string_search.description: Rotate early hit, late hit, absent needle and Unicode hit; return scalar index.

string_split.unit: one full document split and result fold
string_split.description: Split SIZE fields with alternating explicit separators, preserving empty fields.

string_join.unit: one full fragment join and output fold
string_join.description: Join SIZE fields with alternating one/two-byte separators.

int_parse.description: Cycle a seeded working set with valid, negative, leading-zero and malformed text.

int_format.unit: one signed decimal formatting and output fold
int_format.description: Cycle a seeded numeric working set with negative and positive integers.

word_count.description: Tokenize ASCII whitespace and count a mixed UTF-8 vocabulary in a native map.

csv_aggregate.description: Quote-aware CSV records, rejected numeric data, active-row aggregation by region.

json_transform.description: Native-library JSON workload; parse records, filter active rows, change amounts and serialize.

sampling.scope: whole process including taskset/exec launcher, fixtures, formatting, teardown, and runtime threads
sampling.caveat: Unweighted captured CPU-clock samples are fixed-rate sampling evidence; frequency mode can adjust periods. They are not cycles or kernel-only timings.

rule_policy: Only named primitive implementation symbols receive credit. Guest application bodies, hashed functions without a primitive rule, unknown addresses, and parser/interpreter application helpers remain unresolved. Links mean the microcase exercises the named primitive, not that it duplicates the application's input distribution or total cost.
